tasks.title: Push :latest and the version image tag only after the release smoke test passes
acceptance: WHEN `tests/test_r082_release_order.py` runs against the current (unchanged) `release.yml`, THE SYSTEM SHALL fail it, because "Build and push" pushes `:latest` and the version tag before the smoke test. Run the test before changing the workflow to show it catches the bug.

WHEN the step "Build and push" (`docker/build-push-action@v6`, given `id: build`) runs, THE SYSTEM SHALL push only `${{ steps.image.outputs.name }}:${{ steps.version.outputs.sha_tag }}`. Its `with.tags` SHALL contain neither `:latest` nor `steps.version.outputs.version`. Labels, `context`, `cache-from` and `cache-to` stay as they are (R-082).

THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT have any step in job `release` before "Smoke test the published image" whose `with.tags` or `run` contains `:latest`, `imagetools` or a tag built from `steps.version.outputs.version` (R-082).

THE SYSTEM SHALL run the smoke test's `docker run … smoke-web` against `${{ steps.image.outputs.name }}@${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}` instead of the version tag. Every other line of the smoke script stays byte for byte, including the web command shared with `docker-compose.prod.yml` (rules 18, 20; R-082).

WHEN the smoke test step succeeds, THE SYSTEM SHALL run exactly one new step, placed after the smoke test and before "Tag and publish release", that runs `docker buildx imagetools create --tag <name>:<version> --tag <name>:latest <name>@${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}`, with no rebuild. That step SHALL have no `if:` key and no `continue-on-error` (R-082).
THE SYSTEM SHALL NOT set `continue-on-error` or an `if:` key on "Smoke test the published image", the new tagging step or "Tag and publish release" (R-082).
THE SYSTEM SHALL use no new action, runner, registry, secret or permission. The `permissions`, `concurrency`, `on` and `verify` job blocks stay unchanged (rule 2, rule 4).

THE SYSTEM SHALL provide `tests/test_r082_release_order.py`, which loads `.github/workflows/release.yml` with `yaml.safe_load` (no network, no database; rule 19) and asserts each of the following. (1) The file parses and job `release` has a step named "Smoke test the published image". (2) No step before it pushes `:latest` or the version tag, checked as in the criteria above. (3) The smoke step's `run` references `steps.build.outputs.digest`. (4) Exactly one step after the smoke step runs `imagetools create`; its `run` names `:latest`, `steps.version.outputs.version` and `steps.build.outputs.digest`; it has no `if` and no `continue-on-error`; and its index is lower than that of the step whose `run` contains `git tag`. (5) The smoke step's `run` still contains `/healthz`, `Seeded catalog_version=`, `X-Forwarded-Proto: https`, `evil.example.com`, `cache-control` (case-insensitive) and `/static/` (rule 18).

WHEN `python -c "import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/release.yml'))"` runs, THE SYSTEM SHALL exit 0. If `actionlint` is installed, `actionlint .github/workflows/release.yml` SHALL report nothing (it is not installed on this machine today).

THE SYSTEM SHALL update `docs/RELEASE_AND_DEPLOY.md`. (a) The "Model" diagram reads: build + push `sha-` tag, smoke test, tag version + `latest`, git tag + GitHub Release. (b) Under "Versioning", say that `sha-<short>` is pushed before the smoke test and `v…` and `latest` only after it passes, so every `v…` image passed the smoke test and is safe to pin. (c) In "What gates a release", change "After the image is pushed" to say the candidate is pushed under its `sha-` tag and tested by digest. Keep "A broken image therefore never gets tagged or released, so `latest` never moves to it." (now true) and add that the failed candidate's `sha-` tag stays in GHCR. Change no other section.

THE SYSTEM SHALL update `docs/HLD.md` in exactly two places. (a) The "Release" component row (table under components) reads: CI, build and push `sha-…` to GHCR, smoke-test that digest, then tag it `vX.Y.N` and `latest` (`docker buildx imagetools create`), then git tag and GitHub Release. (b) Runtime flow step 5 ("Release and deploy") gets the same order and says watchtower only ever sees a `latest` that passed the smoke test. Change no other line.

THE SYSTEM SHALL keep `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .`, catalog validation (`python tools/validate_catalog.py --data-dir data --config tools/catalog_sources.yaml`) and `pytest` passing, with no network access and no real database (rule 19).
tasks.notes: UI: no. Architecture: unchanged (same job, same registry, same pull-based deploy; rule 4 order now actually holds). Cost: none, no new runner, action or service (rule 2). No file under `src/` changes, so no `ASSET_VERSION` bump (rule 21). Approach: build and push only the sha tag, smoke-test by digest, then add the version and `latest` tags to that digest with `docker buildx imagetools create` (registry-side, so `latest` is exactly the bytes that were tested), then git tag and release. Tag before the git tag, so a tagging failure leaves no git tag and the run can be repeated ("Fail if tag already exists" still passes). Give the build step `id: build` for `steps.build.outputs.digest`. With provenance attestations on (build-push-action v6 default), the digest is an image index; `docker run` and `imagetools create` both accept it. Do not touch the smoke checks (rule 18) or the web command (rule 20). Optionally add a `latest`/version row to the Summary step. PyYAML reaches CI through `pre-commit` in `.[dev]`, as `tools/validate_catalog.py` already relies on; do not add a dependency. Do not fix the other stale parts of `docs/RELEASE_AND_DEPLOY.md` (`PUBLIC_HOSTNAME`, "results page renders"); they are separate follow-ups in `.sdlc/STATUS.md`. QA cannot run the release locally. The check is the first release run after merge: step order in the run log, and `docker buildx imagetools inspect` showing the same digest for `latest`, `v…` and `sha-…`.
